text:
alex_cs: Morning — quick sync for Voyager's private deploy. Want to confirm open items for the enablement session tomorrow (15:00 PT). Main checklist: VPC peering, route/table updates, KMS key policy, audit log forwarding, and IAM role mapping.

maria_sre: VPC peering is in place on our side. I still see no route table entry for the 10.86.0.0/16 -> redwood-transit. Need Voyager to add the route.

jordan_network: @pat_voyager can you confirm whether your firewall team will allow outbound to our peering IP 172.31.12.5? They previously blocked 443 egress to unknown ranges.

pat_voyager: Checking with security now. They said they can allow 172.31.12.5/32 but need the ASN and a maint contact. ASN is 64512, maint contact is netsvc@voyager.co.

alex_cs: Thanks — noted. On KMS: Voyager asked for a customer-managed key with cross-account decrypt for the redwood-inference service principal. We recommend the following minimal key policy. Please review and paste into your key creation flow.

alex_cs: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Sid": "AllowRoot", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::VOYAGER_ACC:root"}, "Action": "kms:*", "Resource": "*"},
    {"Sid": "AllowRedwoodService", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFW_ACC:role/redwood-inference"}, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"], "Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```

sam_cloudops: Two notes: 1) Replace VOYAGER_ACC and REDFW_ACC with the actual account IDs. 2) Voyager's security wants an IAM role trust policy instead of broad account root access. We'll convert to a principal role ARN.

pat_voyager: Understood — will push a role-based policy. Also we need audit logs to go to our SIEM. Does Redwood support pushing CloudTrail logs to a customer S3 bucket?

maria_sre: Yes — we can enable CloudTrail and configure delivery to your bucket. We also recommend an SNS -> SQS hook for real-time alerts. Need your bucket ARN and a write policy.

jordan_network: For the enablement call, please have these ready: 1) example route table entry (CIDR + next-hop), 2) KMS key ARN or policy text, 3) bucket ARN and any cross-account ACLs, 4) test API key for a non-prod env.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Enablement session scheduled: 2026-05-12 15:00 PT. Zoom link posted in calendar. Attendees: alex_cs, maria_sre, jordan_network, pat_voyager, sam_cloudops.

pat_voyager: We have a small blocker — our compliance team requires key rotation within 30 days for CMKs. Is there an automated rotation option that won't break existing ciphertexts?

sam_cloudops: KMS supports automatic rotation for symmetric CMKs. We'll validate the integration path; if Voyager needs external rotation with HSM, we may need an additional config. I'll follow up during the call with options.

alex_cs: Regarding renewal risk — Voyager's account is consumption-heavy in week0 tests. If enablement is delayed more than 7 days, they may push their launch window and we should flag potential impact to their renewal timeline. Capture: high priority enablement.

pat_voyager: Thanks. Our plan is to finish the firewall allowlist and provide the bucket/KMS ARNs by EOD today. Will join the call with our security lead.

maria_sre: Great — I'll prepare the CloudTrail S3 policy and a quick checklist to run during the session.

alex_cs: Perfect. Action items: pat -> provide bucket/KMS ARNs + confirm firewall egress; jordan -> prepare route table example; sam -> validate rotation options; maria -> S3 policy + SNS hook. I'll send a follow-up thread with the checklist after lunch. :thumbsup:

pat_voyager: On it, thanks all.
